title: Can you tell me the way? — идиомы

items.example: How do I get there from here? — Take the number 5 bus.
I think we took a wrong turning — the station is back there.
The museum is just around the corner from the station.
The market is right in the heart of the old town.
The beach is a stone's throw away from the hotel.
There are three restaurants on your doorstep.
Go past the bank and you'll come across it on the left.
